answer_1.quote: We propose Multi-XScience, a large-scale dataset for multi-document summarization using scientific articles. ... the task: write the related work section of a paper using its abstract and reference papers.
answer_1.outputs: Related‑work paragraphs (abstractive summaries) generated from the abstract of the query paper and the abstracts of its references.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE Scores and percentage of novel n‑grams for different models on the Multi‑XScience dataset ...

answer_4.quote: Two human judges evaluated the overlap between the sources and the target on 25 pairs randomly selected from the test set. ... We conduct human evaluation on ext-oracle, HiMAP, and Pointer-Generator... Two human judges are asked to rank system outputs from 1 (worst) to 3 (best).
answer_4.guideline: Judges score fact coverage using a 4‑point scale (75‑100% facts, 50‑75% facts, 25‑50% facts, <25% facts) and rank system outputs from 1 to 3 based on overall quality.
